design-crest-tips-off-feathers.text: Fixed by measuring the tips from the image file, as the session lead asked, rather than copying the skeptic's six points; the skeptic's control is taken as given. scratchpad pr5/r2fix/js/tips.py reads assets/dino.jpg (432 x 558 px), marks its crest-coloured pixels (a warm hue, 12-50 degrees, saturation at least 0.28, value at least 0.45; the grey backdrop is 0.10-0.18 saturated, the tan tips 0.35-0.55), finds each tip's end (the top crest's local tops of the tan mask's top edge, x 125-212, with the leftmost feather's own top, x 130-142, since its top meets the next feather's flank; the neck fringe's local right ends, y 36-180), and puts each spot a little inside it: the centroid of the tan pixels within 9 px of the tip's end (within 7 px left up to 27% of a full glow on the backdrop; 9 px leaves 5-17%). All eleven were re-measured: (0.327, 0.046), (0.359, 0.025), (0.395, 0.015), (0.432, 0.031), (0.473, 0.055), (0.516, 0.097), (0.538, 0.135), (0.570, 0.181), (0.598, 0.221), (0.628, 0.266), (0.653, 0.298), in src/app.html's ART_GLOW.dino and the check's own copy, FEAT.hero. Against the skeptic's points: the first five agree within about 1.5 px; the sixth is the first neck feather's outer end, (224, 54) px, where the skeptic's (213, 45) is that feather's top-left corner; the last five moved 2-5 px from the fringe's inner edge out onto its tips (the task's rule: every spot centred on a tip). Glow-weighted share at full (grow 1.2, the review's overlap.py, pr5/r2fix/js/overlap2.py): 5-17% over the backdrop (the old first six 40-95%), 42-78% over the tan. The Collide picture's spike spots are unchanged: its spikes' sunlit ends are nearly white, so a colour test can't tell a spike from the sky there (its last spot, (0.619, 0.090), reads (204, 180, 184) on the spike's pale end), and glow-features already requires every one of its tips to brighten. Checks: a new pr5 [crest-tips] (every crest-tip spot on the header picture, the page's eleven read from its glow layer and the check's own eleven, sits on crest-coloured pixels of assets/dino.jpg, which the test reads itself: the same colour rule over 3 x 3 px at its centre); pr5 [glow-features] with the new coordinates, every tip now at least +6 (it had been 70% of them), and the skeptic's narrow-window control on the background beside the crest top, (0.48, 0.02) over a half-width of 0.006 of the picture's width. Measured: the header's tips +50.6 on average at 1280 px (each at least +35), +45.5 at 390 px (each at least +36), the background beside the crest 0.0 at both, light and dark. Looked at: crops of the header at 390 and 1280 px, light and dark, at none, a faint glow (the stomp at 10^9 kg, strength 0.262) and full (scratchpad pr5/r2fix/design/crops-new): each glow sits on a feather tip, none in the grey. README decision 21 and test 10. Reverted on its own in a scratch copy (scratchpad pr5/r2fix/js/revert2.py, results in pr5/r2fix/revert2-results.json): {REVERTS}. Restored: the --pr5 block passes.

copy-1.text: Fixed with the skeptic's better fix: below 100% absorbed the Throw tab's item says 'The shimmer (the Shimmer tile) counts their power's P share of what real air would take from this same throw at the full drag[, less what is still in their landing, which Safe passenger takes back]: X. That is not what their power cancels along the flight it actually flies, which slows less than in real air.' It names the figure by what it is, so it is true where the blast's figure is the same (the air's share at 50%) and where it differs. On the page: the baseball at 45 degrees, 10^6 kg, half absorbed: 'The blast near him counts the 50% share of what real air would take from the same throw (36.2 kJ), so 18.1 kJ ... The shimmer (the Shimmer tile) counts their power's 50% share of what real air would take from this same throw at the full drag: 18.1 kJ.'; the car at 20 degrees, half absorbed: 132 kJ, the tile's. Check: pr5 [share-copy] (the car at 20 degrees and the supersonic baseball at 10^6 kg, both half absorbed: the new sentence with the tile's figure and the engine's drag part, the blast's figure equal to it at 50%, and no 'a different figure,' in the bay). README decision 24. Reverted on its own in a scratch copy: {REVERTS}. Restored: the --pr5 block passes.

code-1.text: Fixed with the skeptic's better fix. Engine: takenBack('arm', r, { A, B, whoA }) takes arm wrestling out of TB_NONE and among the two-player moves; with A.unbreakable (the page's one Unbreakable footing switch), a pin that real ground under the table would take as a crater (armWrestle's own crater condition: outcome 'pin', not relativistic, 2 km/s or more, a finite energy) adds r.pin.E as a footing part, the winner's, since his swing drives the slam. That reading is new (decision 25, item 12 on the owner's list; the alternative is the loser's, or a share each): the stomp's rule says whose own move breaks the ground, decision 9 whose own footing holds it; here the ground under the table is neither one's footing, and the winner's swing is the move. Page: the Arm tab's tile row ends with the Shimmer tile, and where the power holds the crater the bay says 'Unbreakable footing: on real ground the pin's slam would drive a crater into the ground under the table (at V). Their power keeps the ground whole, and the energy that would have broken it, E, goes to the endless ocean: W's take, since his swing drives the slam (the Shimmer tile counts it).' No glow: the header follows Rex's own tab and the Arm picture has no glow layer, as for every two-player run but Collide's charge (decision 22, Arm taken out of its list of tabs with nothing taken back). The shimmer card lists the pin's slam under Unbreakable footing; README decisions 2, 22 and 25, Known limits (no footing part past 1% of light speed, where the engine has no crater model, or below 2 km/s). Moved: Rex at 10^9 kg pinning Ollie at his what-if 10^8 kg, all-out (the back of Ollie's hand hits the pad at 8,310 m/s; a crater up to 19.7 m across on real ground): nothing before, 2.01 GJ now, about a faint glow. Checks: test/powers.js 9j code-1 (that pin, Rex's footing part with the power on; the crater real and nothing taken back with it off; Ollie's when he wins, or when he is named A; nothing below 2 km/s, in a stalemate or past 1% of light speed); pr5 [arm] (the tile last in its row, Rex's level, his line with the engine's figure and 'the ground kept whole', and the sentence; with Unbreakable footing switched off on the page, the crater and no tile); pr5 [shimmer-card] (the card's list); docs2.py code1 (README decisions 22 and 25). code-2.text: Fixed with the skeptic's better fix: tbDrag treats a drag part of a part in 10^9 or less of real air's take as rounding (0), and a catch leg's arrival is max(Ecatch, keFromV(vArrive)), the relativistic kinetic energy of its motion as it arrives, the convention realAirLeg counts in; Ecatch itself (a powers-off result) is unchanged, and so is the catch part. Moved: a fastball 10 m apart at 10^14 kg, a drag part of 0.00049 J beside each 3.63 TJ catch, now 0; a fastball 1 km apart at 10^13 kg, 15.2 MJ beside each 363 GJ catch, now 0; a person 31.6 km apart at 10^12 kg, 544 kJ beside each 3.27 TJ catch, now 0. Nothing else in the README moves (scratchpad pr5/r2fix/js/figs2.js runs round 1's figures and the brief's on both engines: all the same). Check: test/powers.js 9j code-2 (a fastball, a person and a car 10 m, 1 km and 31.6 km apart from 10^8 to 10^16 kg, the catch taken back: in the 74 legs where real air's take is no more than the arrival's motion, 14 of them past 1% of light speed and the page's three among them, the drag part is exactly 0 and the catch unchanged; the two legs where it exceeds the arrival, a fastball 316 km apart, keep that excess; and a hard catch at unlimited strength has no drag part beside its unbounded catch). That last case also kills the round's engine mutant N29, which the code lens had judged equivalent: without tbDrag's arrive === Infinity guard, the unlimited hard catch showed an unbounded drag part beside its unbounded catch, which the tile would name. README decision 8. Reverted on its own in a scratch copy, and N29 with section 9 as now and as at f6d20c3: {REVERTS}. Restored: section 9 passes.
